method: manual editorial, source-section bounded; scores are content evidence, not learner skill or production validation

scale.0: Not demonstrable in selected owning section
scale.1: Explained or proposed but not operationally demonstrated
scale.2: Concrete, inspectable or reproducible criterion in owning chapter/context; not live customer proof

items.gap_zh: Schema 合法与业务真值被混同；缺反例测例及拒判门禁。

items.pass_zh: 无论格式多正确，错误订单/权限被拒绝；保留 trace、审计和负例。
items.pass_en: Wrong order or scope is denied despite valid JSON; preserve traces and negative cases.

items.gap_zh: 有机制比较，缺可执行的逐组成本/成功任务验收。

items.drill_en: Design rules/small/large-model routing without cheap-model misrouting.
items.pass_zh: 按关键切片给出升级率、漏升级率与成功任务成本。
items.pass_en: Report escalation, missed-escalation and cost per approved task by slice.

items.gap_zh: 已有权限边界与负例方案；仍需要真实资源身份集成验证。

items.drill_en: Same order ID in two tenants; revoke access between retrieval and paragraph fetch.
items.pass_zh: 禁止跨租户候选进入上下文；缓存/日志也不泄漏；记录撤权→拒绝延迟。
items.pass_en: No unauthorized context/cache/logs; record revocation-to-denial lag.

items.gap_zh: 召回融合流程完善，仍需 ID/政策查询分层的实测消融。

items.drill_en: Choose exact, BM25 and dense routes for an order-ID plus carrier SLA query.
items.pass_zh: 给出受权限限制的 Recall@k、无关候选率、p95、成本。
items.pass_en: Report authorized recall, irrelevant candidates, p95 and cost.

items.gap_zh: Rerank 介绍分散，缺候选无法召回时的失败回归和来源验证。

items.pass_zh: 说清上游召回上限，验证 rerank 在相同候选集中的改善。
items.pass_en: Explain first-stage recall ceiling; measure rerank gains on fixed candidates.

items.gap_zh: 有具体反例与论文来源；缺可执行的 protected-slot 断言。

items.drill_en: Apply HyDE to 'not order 42, order 43' while pinning slots.
items.pass_zh: 证明不改写租户、order ID、否定词；生成文本不能当证据引用。
items.pass_en: Preserve tenant, order ID and negation; never cite hypothetical content.

items.gap_zh: 已有版本契约与本地负例；未验证真实向量索引的迁移收益。

items.drill_en: Old/new embeddings share dimensions but are mixed: detect and migrate.
items.pass_zh: 匹配 query/document encoder，影子索引对比权限召回，失败时原子回滚。
items.pass_en: Match query/doc encoders, compare shadow authorized recall and rollback atomically.

items.gap_zh: 索引可见性与权限 SLI 已分离；尚无真实端到端时钟与缓存压测。

items.drill_en: A revoked document persists in vector-cache results: design denial.
items.pass_zh: 可验证 Source→Visible lag 和 Revocation→Deny lag，权限失败阻断发布。
items.pass_en: Measure source-to-visible and revocation-to-deny; access leak blocks release.

items.gap_zh: 组件边界清楚；缺具体 JSON tool schema 到资源级授权的完整实验。

items.drill_en: MCP exposes delete_order, but user has no delete entitlement.

items.pass_en: Host denies execution with audit; model args cannot override tenant.

items.gap_zh: 有 Host 模式与隔离设计，缺一次完整真实服务响应验证。

items.pass_zh: 工具 Broker 读策略拒绝；验证没有后端写入或暴露敏感结果。
items.pass_en: Tool broker denies; no backend write or sensitive output.

items.concept: Agent vs Workflow vs a Single Call
items.gap_zh: 多种控制结构论述充分；缺同一任务的消融式接受试验。
items.drill_zh: 订单时间线异常分类需要单次 SQL、Workflow 还是 Multi-Agent？
items.drill_en: Order chronology classifier: single call, workflow or multi-agent?
items.pass_zh: 优先确定性执行；比较状态数量、故障恢复、延迟和人审。
items.pass_en: Favor deterministic path; compare state, recovery, latency and review.

items.gap_zh: 循环上限与审批存在；端到端支付批准/取消语义未集成验证。
items.drill_zh: Agent 想自动退款并持续重试，设计人工审批与停止状态机。
items.drill_en: Agent wants automatic refund and retries: design approval/stop state.
items.pass_zh: 超时进入 UNKNOWN，批准作用域不可变，重试需幂等与总预算。
items.pass_en: Timeout becomes UNKNOWN; immutable approval scope and bounded idempotent retries.

items.gap_zh: 治理层明确；长期记忆污染/撤权的可运行回归较少。
items.drill_zh: 客服上一会话记录订单隐私，权限撤回后如何更新 Memory？
items.drill_en: Private order data was remembered; access is now revoked: how to handle memory?
items.pass_zh: 撤权后不再读取缓存记忆，保留来源/TTL/版本，回归负测。
items.pass_en: Revoke cached memory access; retain provenance, TTL, version and negative tests.

items.gap_zh: 可分层抽样与 Holdout；未有跨客户标注一致率实测。
items.drill_zh: 线上 70% vs Pilot 95%，设计避免泄漏的 Golden Dataset。
items.drill_en: Production 70% vs pilot 95%: design leakage-resistant gold data.
items.pass_zh: 按租户/查询/风险分层，独立封存数据，记录争议裁决。
items.pass_en: Stratify tenant/query/risk, seal holdout, document adjudication.

items.concept: Agentic Evals: Grading the Trajectory, Not the Answer
items.gap_zh: 轨迹风险解释充分；需真实 Tool Trace 驱动的回归。

items.pass_zh: 失败；同时评分最终事实和工具路径、预算、状态、副作用。
items.pass_en: Fail; grade factual outcome, trajectory, budget, state and side effects.

items.gap_zh: 列出 Judge Bias，但缺真实人工标注校准误差分布。

items.drill_en: A judge favors verbose unsafe answers: calibrate and detect bias.
items.pass_zh: 分离结构检测/人审，报告 Human Agreement、Pairwise Bias 与置信区间。
items.pass_en: Separate deterministic/human checks; report agreement, bias and uncertainty.

items.gap_zh: 概率概念有来源；缺真实分桶 Calibration 曲线实验。

items.pass_zh: 独立标注、可靠性曲线、Brier及切片漂移；未校准不能当概率。
items.pass_en: Held-out labels, reliability plot, Brier and slices; uncalibrated isn't probability.

items.concept: Eval Regression Suites and CI Gates
items.heading_contains: How would you implement CI gates

items.pass_en: Freeze slice gates, block regression and retain canary/rollback evidence.

items.gap_zh: CH09 是归属章节，但精确 SLO/分母/预算算式在 CH10 §10.26，存在跨章节依赖。

items.pass_en: Illustrate 100 normal misses; unauthorized access always blocks.

items.heading_contains: data must remain in our VPC

items.heading_contains: circuit breaker rather than more retries
items.gap_zh: 上限、熔断和测试计划明确；未做真实故障注入/饱和基准。

items.pass_en: Bound attempts/queues; measure recovery, p95 and amplification.

items.gap_zh: 业务 key 与 UNKNOWN 处理清楚；支付网关副作用未做真实集成测试。

items.pass_en: Never mint a new key; reconcile receipt with stable operation ID.

items.gap_zh: 语义层案例有，但缺 business owner 签署后的时态规则回归。

items.gap_zh: 公式说明了归因，但没有按真实 Cohort 的成本口径和数据校核。

items.gap_zh: AUTO CDC 顺序和快照阐述好；实际客户重放/保留配置未测试。

items.pass_zh: 检查 Source Sequence/Offset、Tombstone、SCD2 区间与对账。
items.pass_en: Verify sequence/offset, tombstones, SCD2 intervals and reconciliation.

items.pass_en: Pin sources/offsets, replay and reconcile input/output counts.

items.gap_zh: 强制 Scope 和 AST 已说明；真实 UC RLS 端到端未验证。

items.pass_en: No; enforce both effective_at and available_at historical constraints.

items.gap_zh: ROW_NUMBER/SCD2 例子有；缺真实 Delta 处理多源顺序的运行测试。

items.pass_en: Define one task, policy, sources, abstention, owner and non-goals.

items.gap_zh: 现有 SQLite 演示可运行，但不构成真实 SSO/云端纵切部署。

items.pass_zh: 不能；至少真实身份、保护源、一次任务、Trace 和部署回滚。
items.pass_en: No; need real identity, protected source, task, trace and rollback.

items.gap_zh: 已有预检与降级方法；缺一套分钟级现场恢复演练和客户验收量化。
